info.title: Rag_System_AI - Modular Monolith
info.description:
Scientific Journal Publication Trend Tracking System.

Unified Modular Monolith RAG Pipeline covering all 12 Steps across 4 Phases:
- Phase 1: Ingestion (Steps 1-4: Data Sources, Loading, Meaningful Chunking, Metadata Extraction)
- Phase 2: Indexing (Steps 5-6: Embeddings, Vector Database)
- Phase 3: Retrieval (Steps 7-9: Query Rewriting, Hybrid Search, Cross-Encoder Reranking)
- Phase 4: Generation & Evaluation (Steps 10-12: Context Assembly, LLM Generation, Evaluation)

get.description: Returns service health status and environment.

get.description: Retrieves document metadata, processing status, and text chunks.

post.description: Transforms text chunks into dense floating point embedding vectors.
Performs semantic vector lookup, hybrid search, and cross-encoder reranking.
Analyzes the research query into direct_lookup, relational_reasoning, hybrid, or chitchat with routing flags and filters.
Synthesizes a citation-grounded response using an LLM conditioned on assembled context.
Unified entry point. Coordinates retrieval, hybrid search, reranking, context assembly, LLM generation, optional chat history recording, and multi-turn context memory.
